visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side image and text; the text column is centred vertically
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile (image first); side by side from 900px with a 64-96px gap
visualCharacteristics.typography: heading font headings; 16/28 body with .32px tracking

contentPattern.structure: each row holds the columns; a cell with only an image is an image column. Swap the cells to put the image on the right

usage: Brand intros and any image + copy pairing.
reuseGuidance: Keep one image cell and one text cell per row for the two-column layout. Rows can alternate the image side.
